brief.headline: Fix the 40% return rate first, then push for ₹0.65–0.80/piece pricing at higher volume

priceAsk.summary: Target ₹0.65–0.80 per piece for caps at higher volume or relaxed spec
priceAsk.basis: The market ask for a 28 mm induction-wad PP cap is ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc. The verdict says there's modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume or looser spec — so we should push toward that lower band if we commit more volume or adjust requirements.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Keep 30 Days After Receipt — no change needed

brief.financialLeverage: Scorpion publishes no financials, so we can't see their profit, debt or how tight their cash is. Our ₹1.66 L annual spend is tiny — we have almost no revenue pull here. That said, their 40% return rate screams process or quality trouble, which gives us the upper hand: they need to keep us happy or risk losing even this small account. We should lean on the quality problem and the fact that we have five strong packaging alternates ready to step in.

evidence.point: Four in ten deliveries get returned or reversed
Our annual spend with them is very small
Market ask for 28 mm PP cap runs ₹0.55–1.20 per piece, typically ₹0.85–0.95
Market verdict says there's modest room down to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume or looser spec
We pay them within 30 days of receipt

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter, does pharma bottles and caps, health score B (65/100), revenue ₹2569.83 Cr — the top second-source candidate to replace or pressure Scorpion

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader for pails, containers and pharma; strong and profitable — a robust alternate for bottles and closures

alternates.name: Hitech Corporation Ltd
alternates.why: Listed maker of moulded and blow-moulded packaging with broad capability across bottles and caps

risks: The 40% return rate means quality or paperwork is broken — push too hard on price before they fix it and we just get more rejects
Our ₹1.66 L spend is tiny, so they may not prioritize us; line up Manjushree or Mold-Tek now so we have real walk-away power
Scorpion's financials aren't public, so we're flying blind on whether they're cash-strapped or stable — watch for late shipments or sudden payment-term requests as red flags
The market-backup leads (Reliance, Srichakra, IVL Dhunseri, Dalmia, Ganesha, Chemco) are unqualified — verify and get quotes before treating any as a real option
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We need to talk about the 40% return rate — let's agree on a quality action plan first, then we can discuss moving more volume to you at the ₹0.65–0.80 market rate for higher quantities.
